## Summary
What this PR does, in 2–4 sentences. Focus on the why.

## Related issue
Closes #

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] Feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (note required, migration steps below)
- [ ] Refactor / docs / tooling only

## How to test
1. Steps, exact commands, sample payloads.
2. Expected observable result.

## Evidence
- [ ] `dart analyze` — 0 errors
- [ ] Unit / integration tests pass (`dart test`)
- [ ] Manual E2E verified (describe scenario + result)
- Attach screenshot or sample response for user-visible change.

## Checklist
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Self-reviewed diff; no debug code, no commented-out blocks
- [ ] API docs / OpenAPI spec / README updated where behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or customer data in the diff
- [ ] Migration or deploy notes written if needed

## Notes for reviewers
Areas you want scrutiny on. Anything intentionally left out.
